text: I think the biggest cause is cars, because there are so many of them in big cities. Factories also make a lot of smoke, and in winter many people burn coal to stay warm. For example, in my city the sky is often grey, and you can feel it in your throat. I believe cars are the worst because everybody uses them every day.

tips.en: An example from your own city makes the answer personal.
tips.kk: Өз қаласынан алынған мысал жауапты жеке етеді.
tips.ru: Пример из своего города делает ответ личным.
tips.example: For example, in my city the sky is often grey

tips.en: 'because' explains clearly why cars are the main cause.
tips.kk: «because» жалғауы көліктердің басты себеп екенін анық түсіндіреді.
tips.ru: Союз «because» чётко объясняет, почему машины — главная причина.
tips.example: because there are so many of them in big cities

questions.question: What are the main causes of air pollution in cities?

text: Yes, I do, because cycling is good for health and it doesn't make any pollution. It is also faster than a car when there is a traffic jam. But in many cities, it's not safe because there are no bike lanes. If the city builds more lanes, I think more people will try it. Also, it is cheap, so people save money.

tips.en: 'But' introduces a real problem and makes the answer more honest.
tips.kk: «But» нақты мәселені енгізіп, жауапты шынайырақ етеді.
tips.ru: «But» вводит реальную проблему и делает ответ честнее.
tips.example: But in many cities, it's not safe because there are no bike lanes

tips.en: A first conditional offers a solution.
tips.kk: Бірінші типті шартты сөйлем шешім ұсынады.
tips.example: If the city builds more lanes, I think more people will try it

note.en: a long line of stopped cars

questions.question: Do you think people should use bicycles more?

text: I think companies have more responsibility because they produce much more waste than one person. For example, a big factory can pollute a whole river. But individuals also must do their part, like saving water and electricity at home. I think the government should check companies and give them a fine if they break the rules. When everybody helps, the result is better.

tips.en: A simple vivid example supports the argument.
tips.example: For example, a big factory can pollute a whole river

tips.en: 'But' adds the second side and balances the answer.
tips.kk: «But» екінші жағын қосып, жауапты теңгерімді етеді.
tips.ru: «But» добавляет вторую сторону и делает ответ сбалансированным.
tips.example: But individuals also must do their part

note.en: to make them pay a penalty

questions.question: Who should be responsible for protecting the environment, individuals or companies?

text: I hope so, but I'm not completely sure. More people now know about pollution, and many countries are making electric cars and building solar farms. But at the same time, cities are growing, so there will be more traffic and more waste. I think it will improve a little if governments are serious. Maybe it will take longer than ten years.

tips.en: The qualifier 'not completely sure' sounds honest and natural.
tips.kk: «not completely sure» ескертпесі адал әрі табиғи естіледі.
tips.ru: Оговорка «not completely sure» звучит честно и естественно.
tips.example: I hope so, but I'm not completely sure

tips.en: Worrying factors are added after the good news.
tips.kk: Жақсы жаңалықтан кейін алаңдататын факторлар қосылған.
tips.ru: После хороших новостей добавлены тревожные факторы.
tips.example: But at the same time, cities are growing

questions.question: Do you think the situation will improve in the next ten years?
